requirements.title: 偶数个连续反斜杠后的尾随空格应被裁剪，并正确匹配字面反斜杠文件名
requirements.quote:
With an even number of backslashes, Git treats that space as unescaped and trims it. This patch checks backslash parity before deciding whether to preserve the space.

A pattern containing two backslashes followed by a space should match a filename ending in one literal backslash.

requirements.title: 奇数个连续反斜杠仍应保留转义的尾随空格
requirements.quote: The new regression module covers both pattern classes and PathSpec; odd backslash runs continue to preserve escaped spaces.

requirements.title: 两种模式类及 PathSpec 接口均应落实尾随空格修复
requirements.quote: The new regression module covers both pattern classes and PathSpec; odd backslash runs continue to preserve escaped spaces.

open_questions: PRD 的基线结果声明 failures 为 6，但 failed_cases 仅列出 4 项；其余两项是否属于预先存在的失败，还是遗漏了本次修复相关用例？
PRD 未明确多个尾随空格、转义空格后再跟未转义空格以及尾随制表符的处理规则；diff 使用 rstrip() 并声称裁剪最长未转义尾随空格段，这些边界行为需要澄清，不能直接作为新增产品要求。
